title: ID0467235-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multiple] chargers are not shown in sififnty portal
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Charger 170002483 hasn't been updated to firmware 8.0.5.
Solution: Customer was missing
Both chargers 170002483 & 170002482 are not shown in the
Sifinity portal.
